description.value: Mr. Ho Wonton House is a Chinese restaurant on Kingsway in Burnaby serving fresh wonton, noodle soups, congee, hot pot, and a broad menu of classic Cantonese dishes. The restaurant offers indoor seating with air conditioning, and accepts online orders for both pickup and delivery via its own app. It sits on a busy arterial cycling corridor connecting Burnaby to Vancouver.
